eligibility_evidence: We're partnering with an established international technology business investing in a new, security-focused cloud platform for the US government market.
Eligibility Applicants must be US citizens or lawful permanent residents, reside and work within the United States, and be eligible for the required background and identity verification checks.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is an opportunity to become the first dedicated cloud engineer on a growing team, taking a hands-on role in building a secure Microsoft Azure Government environment and establishing the infrastructure and operational practices that will support it long term. Working with security and compliance specialists to ensure the environment meets relevant federal security requirements. What We're Looking For Strong, hands-on experience building and operating Microsoft Azure infrastructure in production. The ability to understand cloud architecture while remaining actively involved in hands-on engineering. Exposure to FedRAMP, NIST security controls, DoD cloud requirements or comparable compliance frameworks.
